Name: The Museum Collection Explained
Author: tiakall
Description:
Tweaks the museum opening event to give an actual explanation of what happened to the previous collection, inspired by all the niche and offbeat museums set up in shacks off the side of an interstate.

Config options: choose between three types of former collections (affects dialogue).

Won't be compatible with any mods that change the opening event (ARE there any?).  Currently, that's all it changes. Maybe I'll add more later (get scope creeped lol)
